title: psoralea retrorsa
intro: Psoralea retrorsa, commonly known as Yin Chen Hao, is a plant species native to China and Southeast Asia, belonging to the family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to promote liver and kidney detoxification, improve digestion, and enhance immune function. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea retrorsa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-fibrotic properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of liver and kidney disease. The bioactive constituents of Psoralea retrorsa include psoralen, isopsoralen, and other flavonoids and phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
